chapter.verse: note' lungsim hong hehnem henla nahoih thuhoih kici khempeuh ah hong thakhauhsak ta hen.
A tawpna ah sanggamte aw, note' kiang dan mahin Topa' thu manlangtak kizelin minphatna a om nadingin thu hong ngetsak un.
A siahuai a gilo mite' khut pan ka suahtak nading uh zong hong ngetsak un. A hang pen mi khempeuh muanhuai kimlo hi.
Ahih hangin Topa muanhuai hi. Amah in note hong lamkip ding a, Gilo' kiangpan hong kemcing ding hi.
Tua banah kong thupiakte uh na hih uh a, hih lai ding ci-in zong note tawh kisai-in Topa' sungah sunglam kimuanna ka nei uh hi.
Topa in note' lungsim Pasian' itna lam leh Khris' thuakzawhna lam hong manawhsak ta hen.
Tu-in sanggamte aw, i Topa Jesu Khris' min tawh note kong thupiak uhah: ko' tungpan na san uh zatngeizia thu bangin a gamta lo, a thadah a zulhtat sanggam peuhmah peel un.
A hang pen note' kiangah kong om lai-un thadah zulhtat lo ka hih manun nomau' etteh dingte ka hihlam uh nomaumah in na theih uh ahi hi.
A khawnkhongin kuamah ii an kong neksak kei uh a, note khatpeuh' tungah vangik ka suahloh nadingun a sun a zan ci lo-in hahkatin na ka sem uh hi.
Tua pen hihtheihna thu a neilo ka hikei uh a, note' ciin dingin komaumah etsakna lim khatin hong kipia ka hi uh hi.
A hang pen note' kiangah kong om lai nangawnun hih bangin thupiak kong nei khin uh hi: Nasem nuamlo mi peuhmah an ne kei ta hen.
A hang pen note' sungpan kimkhat a nuntakzia uh, sep kician lah nei lo, milak kihel supsupin thadah zulhtat cih thu ka za uh hi.
Tu-in tua bang mite daitak nasemin amau' thalawhsa an a nek nadingun Topa Jesu Khris' sungah thupia-in kong thum uh hi.
Sanggamte aw, no na hih uhleh nahoih sep ding cimtaak kei un.
Hih laikhak sunga ka thugente uh a manglo khatpeuh a om leh tuanu tuapa ciamteh unla, a maizum theih nadingin kikholhpih nawn kei un.
Ahih hangin gal bangin ngaihsun kei unla, sanggam bangin taaibawl un.
Tu-in nopna lemna Topa in note a tawntungin leh a namkimin nopna lemna hong pia henla note na vekun hong ompih ta hen.
Keimah Paul in keima' khut mahmah tawh hih hopihna kong gelh hi. Hih pen laikhak khempeuh tunga ka gelh ciaptehna lim ahi hi.
